name: Moral Chameleon
body:
You can change orders quickly and retain some of your prior training.

Prerequisite: Order class feature

Benefit: When you change orders, you keep your existing order abilities instead of gaining the abilities from your new order. You do not lose your order abilities when changing orders, but you may do so only 1/level.

Special: If you lose this feat for any reason, you must take the order abilities of your current order instead of those you have from prior orders.
